To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed a novel strategy to construct a high-indexed PtNi alloy skin spiraled on Pd nanowire core, which exhibits a superior catalytic performance for ORR.
a PtNi alloy skin with high index exposed facets can be epitaxially grown on a Pd nanowire core, which shows a highly efficient and stable oxygen reduction catalytic activity.
we successfully synthesized a new type of highly active and durable Pt based catalyst for the oxygen reduction reaction by designing a helical PtNi skin bounded with Hif on a Pd NWs core.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of high-indexed PtNi alloy skins spiraled on Pd nanowire (NW) core to enhance oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) catalysis.
the design of highly efficient and stable core-shell PtNi alloyed nanostructures for oxygen reduction reaction (ORR).
the development of highly active PtNi alloy skin on Pd nanowire catalysts for oxygen electroreduction reactions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this work provides a facile and effective strategy to synthesize a highly efficient and stable ORR electrocatalyst by constructing high index Pt alloys on Pd NWs.
the high-index PtNi alloy skins spiraled on the Pd NWs are a highly efficient and stable electrocatalysts for oxygen reduction reaction.
the high indexed PtNi alloy skin spiraled on Pd NWs exhibits excellent ORR activity and stability, which is promising for the practical application of Pt based catalyst.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a facile strategy for the synthesis of Pt based alloyed high index skin on 1D Pd nanostructures.
we successfully extended high indexed Pt alloys with high activity to the core shell structure.
the high indexed PtNi skin spiraled on Pd nanowire core is a highly efficient and stable oxygen reduction reaction catalyst, with the mass activity of 10 times higher than that of commercial Pt/C.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the synthesis of Pt based alloyed HIFs on 1D Pd nanowire can significantly improve the catalytic activity and stability of ORR.
we can design and prepare a highly active and stable ORR electrocatalyst with a high index skin spiraled on a 1D Pd NW core.
we can design new, efficient, and stable catalysts for fuel cells by using a combination of 1D nanocrystals and high index facets.
